verdict.rationale: Muse's own homepage confirms an official Muse app on Mac alongside mobile and WhatsApp, so the desktop-app part of the story is documented. Nothing in the pack shows OS-level keyboard shortcuts or any ability to see or use what is on the user's screen; its 'own computer' is a remote VM, not the user's desktop. missing for 10: OS-level/global shortcuts, screen-content access or screen awareness, any detail on Mac app capabilities beyond chat, independent corroboration of the desktop app.
